why: I checked every command in both briefs against the repo. Everything they name exists at this commit: bin/csv2json.js, test/*.js, README.md, and the `npm test` script ("node --test"). Neither brief uses the issue's missing `npm run test:cli`; both use `npm test` instead. The printf format strings contain no stray `%`. Check 5 correctly uses `printf '%s\n' '[{"a\tb":"1\t2"}]'`, which keeps a literal backslash-t. `cmp -` with `<(...)` is valid bash, and the brief says to run in bash. `grep -n -- '--tsv' test/*.js` and the same grep on README.md are well-formed. The redirect to /tmp/v1.out followed by `echo "exit=$?"` correctly captures node's exit status. In the builder brief, the JS literal `'[{"a\\tb":"1\\t2"}]\n'` correctly gives the JSON tab escape, and the execFileSync args `['bin/csv2json.js', '--tsv']` fit the existing test pattern. The advisory `node bin/csv2json.js foo --tsv` is valid too, because the CLI ignores unknown arguments.
